describes: packages/plugin/stage: placement, selectors, settings, navigation, reveal, manipulation and responsive rules, frameless.

cases.name: places-on-the-first-real-viewport
cases.covers: Before placement the screen selectors answer the stable empties; a zero-height viewport is stored but does not place; the first real one runs placeInitial (reset to page 0) and publishes PLACED last.

cases.name: a-document-with-no-pages
cases.covers: With no pages placement never starts from setViewport; an explicit placeInitial publishes PLACED over an empty scene, and every verb and selector is a harmless no-op on it.

cases.name: initial-view-providers
cases.covers: placeInitial asks providers from the highest priority down (a stable sort: equal priorities keep registration order); the first non-null view wins through applyViewState and PLACED follows.

cases.name: providers-all-null-reset
cases.covers: When every provider answers null placeInitial resets to page 0.

cases.name: restored-view-without-a-cursor
cases.covers: applyViewState with no cursor lands on page 0 (`view.cursor ?? 0`) and restores the anchor there.

cases.name: selectors
cases.covers: Every read after the default placement, on the default web settings (96/72 view units per point).

cases.name: hit-testing
cases.covers: pageAt inverts the snapped transform of the page under the point (null over a gap); pointOnPage projects unclamped onto a visible page (null when not laid out); pageToWorld and pageRectToScreen go through the quarter-turn matrix; rotation, userUnit and a device ratio of 2 included.

cases.name: setters-by-effect-class
cases.covers: Each setter lands one PATCH and reacts by its registry class: scene settings rebuild and re-anchor at anchorAlign, reclamp settings re-clamp in place, none settings only store, and a flow change re-places the cursor page.

cases.name: zoom-intents
cases.covers: zoomTo and the fit shorthands are zoom-intent updates that hold the zoomAlign point; zoomIn/zoomOut magnify around it by 1.2 and record the level; zoomMode reads custom for levels and page-width specs.

cases.name: fit-all
cases.covers: Under fit-all the subject is the whole scene: resize, refit and scene changes re-place it (centered even when unbounded), and next/prev always step by item.

cases.name: view-rotation
cases.covers: rotateView steps a quarter-turn relative (90 or anything else as 270), setViewRotation sets it absolutely; each is an anchor-preserving scene change that rotates every page footprint.

cases.name: wrapped-grid
cases.covers: A grid with auto columns wraps to the padded viewport line at the effective zoom: a fixed level keys it exactly, resizes re-wrap and keep the page, zoomAround re-pins the focal point when the scene re-wraps, and fit-modes converge through stabilized.

cases.name: screen-px-settings-under-a-fit-mode
cases.covers: A {px} gap and a pageFrame under a fit mode convert at the camera zoom and quantize the scene key; the reveal box includes the chrome bands.

cases.name: paged-flow
cases.covers: Paged flow renders a one-item slice at the cursor: next/prev step items, pans never move the cursor, bare reveal navigates, fit-width fits the current page, and the scroller reads the slice.

cases.name: spreads-step-by-item-or-page
cases.covers: next/prev step by spread while the spread fits the padded viewport and by page when zoomed in past it, clamping at both ends; currentItemPages reports the spread.

cases.name: rtl-horizontal
cases.covers: Horizontal RTL: items advance leftward, start/start lands top-right, spreads bind on the right, and the focal and anchor points are logical.

cases.name: go-to-page
cases.covers: goToPage is a canonical arrival: it clamps the index, lands the subject at arrivalAlign (a per-call override wins, keep holds an axis), clamps within the true bounds even unbounded, and tags the cause programmatic.

cases.name: viewpoint-round-trip
cases.covers: viewpoint() captures the anchor at anchorAlign and the zoom intent; goToPage with a viewpoint restores it instead of placing fresh.

cases.name: bare-reveal
cases.covers: A bare reveal is minimal movement: a visible page leaves the camera alone, an off-screen one scrolls just enough (outer box, smooth or instant without frames), and the cursor never moves.

cases.name: positioned-reveal-zooms
cases.covers: A positioned reveal moves the cursor up front and resolves its zoom directive (level, fit, fit-width, fit-height, keep) against the target rect or the whole page; a degenerate point with a fit directive pans only; a resolved zoom becomes the intent.

cases.name: positioned-reveal-anchors
cases.covers: Anchor axes: keep holds the camera, start/end put the rect edge a padding in, center and fractions put its center at that line (fractions clamp to 0..1); an absent axis is nearest without a zoom change (already visible, above, below, larger than the view) and center with one.

cases.name: reveal-in-a-wrapped-grid
cases.covers: A positioned reveal whose zoom re-wraps a wrapped grid re-places against the new scene (instant: stabilized; smooth without frames: one recompute).

cases.name: camera-writes
cases.covers: setCamera and panBy clamp, tag the cause user and sync the cursor from the camera; unbounded they roam freely; the cause flips back to programmatic on navigation only when it changed.

cases.name: scroller
cases.covers: scrollMetrics reads the camera as a DOM scroller over the clamp range; scrollTo is absolute and clamped with omitted axes held; scrollBy adds to the current offsets; both sync the cursor; smooth without frames is instant.

cases.name: gestures-without-frames
cases.covers: A gesture bracket defers the zoom-intent PATCH to the outermost endGesture; a pan-only gesture commits nothing; an unmatched endGesture is ignored; an elastic pan stretches past the clamp on the rubber curve (a fitting axis stays rigid) and the release snaps home when there are no frames; fling without frames snaps into bounds.

cases.name: double-tap-ladder-without-frames
cases.covers: doubleTapZoom climbs automatic, fit-width, 2.5x automatic and wraps, committing each target as a level up front; off the ladder it resets to the base rung; without frames each tap lands at once, focal point held.

cases.name: scroller-memo-per-field
cases.covers: The scroller memo answers the new metrics when any one of its six numbers moves alone: top, height, width, client height and client width.

cases.name: px-gap-follows-the-zoom
cases.covers: With a {px} gap and no page frame, a zoom write alone re-keys the scene through the quantized gap.

cases.name: paged-slice-rekeys
cases.covers: In paged flow the next slice can land the camera exactly where it was; the scene key still moves, so the visible pages follow.

cases.name: the-fits-predicate-width
cases.covers: next steps by spread only while the spread fits the padded viewport width with half a pixel of slack: zooms just inside, just outside and around the padding bound.

cases.name: the-fits-predicate-height
cases.covers: The same predicate on a spread whose height binds.

cases.name: positioned-reveal-anchors-zoomed
cases.covers: Reveal anchors at zoom 2 with a padding of 30, where dividing and multiplying by the zoom differ; a nearest reveal whose extent is exactly the padded view end-aligns.

cases.name: bare-reveal-outer-box
cases.covers: A bare reveal of pages smaller than the viewport scrolls the outer box, pageFrame bands on all four sides, horizontally and vertically.

cases.name: focal-points-in-ltr
cases.covers: Named zoomAlign stops are physical in LTR: end holds the right padded edge, start the left.

cases.name: double-tap-on-a-phone
cases.covers: On a narrow box automatic is fit-width: the ladder dedupes to two rungs, and the top rung is within 1.1 of nothing else.

cases.name: a-caught-extreme-stretch
cases.covers: Catching a stretch near the rubber asymptote caps the overshoot just under the viewport dimension so the inverse stays finite.

cases.name: default-compact-rule
cases.covers: The default rule gives a compact box (width at most 600) a padding of 4 and names it; crossing back releases it to the base; activeRules only republishes when the names change.

cases.name: rules-and-the-base
cases.covers: Setters write the base and a matching rule wins until it stops matching; only keys whose effective value changed re-assert; a predicate rule sees the box; setResponsive swaps rules and re-resolves; applyViewState writes the base under the rules.

cases.name: a-rule-flips-the-flow
cases.covers: A rule that changes flow at a viewport crossing escalates the resize to a re-placement on the cursor page; one that changes a scene setting rebuilds.

cases.name: responsive-opt-out
cases.covers: responsive: [] opts out: a compact box keeps the base padding and no rule is active.

cases.name: rigid-axes-under-an-elastic-gesture
cases.covers: An axis whose content fits the viewport has no rubber: an elastic drag moves only the travelling axis, and a fling discards the fitting axis velocity (without frames it snaps into bounds).

cases.name: a-page-without-a-user-unit
cases.covers: A registry entry without userUnit reads as 1 in the page transform baseline.

cases.name: double-tap-in-paged-flow
cases.covers: In paged flow the double-tap ladder resolves against the current slice item.

cases.name: two-lenses
cases.covers: stagePlugin({id, token}) registers an independent lens: its own slice, camera and settings, and lensId reports its id.

cases.name: v3-page-verbs
cases.covers: goToPage and reveal take a PageRef and ignore a page the document lacks; goToFirstPage and goToLastPage clamp to the ends; canGoNext and canGoPrevious read the cursor; revealRect is a positioned reveal; isPageVisible, getCurrentPage and pageToViewport read the laid-out pages.

cases.name: v3-zoom-verbs
cases.covers: zoomTo with a bare number writes a fixed level intent, or with around holds that point; zoomBy multiplies around the zoomAlign point or a given one; fitAutomatic is the automatic intent.

cases.name: reset-settings
cases.covers: resetSettings writes the constructed config back as the base and re-resolves it, with the usual anchor-preserving reaction.

cases.name: withdrawn-initial-view
cases.covers: provideInitialView returns an unsubscribe; a provider withdrawn before placement is never asked, and a second call of the unsubscribe is harmless.
